title: A quarter of Nvidia’s business next year comes from labs it is financing
summary: Nvidia has invested nearly $50 billion into AI labs that purchase its chips, with commitments exceeding $500 billion, and CFO Colette Kress revealed these financed labs will account for roughly a quarter of Nvidia's business next year, creating a circular financing model in the AI industry.
problem_solved: This article illuminates the interconnected financial relationships and potential market risks in the AI chip industry where Nvidia both finances and supplies AI research labs.
why_valuable: It reveals a significant circular business dependency in AI infrastructure that could impact market stability and raise regulatory concerns about market concentration.
